title: Explicit decision and assignment
input_or_task: Transcript: Maya: We need one launch date. Owen: I can ship by 14 May. Maya: Agreed, we will launch on 14 May. Priya, please update the customer email by Friday. Priya: I will.
expected_outcome: A grounded summary of the confirmed launch decision and assigned email action.
required_behaviour: Report 14 May as a confirmed launch decision; report Priya updating the customer email by Friday as an action; reference supporting lines.
must_not_happen: Do not change the date, owner, or deadline; do not add actions.

title: Suggestion is not a decision
input_or_task: Transcript: Lee: Maybe we should raise the price to £20. Sam: I am not convinced; let's review the research next week. Lee: Fine.
expected_outcome: The £20 price is identified as a proposal and no approval is claimed.
required_behaviour: Label £20 as a proposal; describe price review as unresolved or a future discussion only if no owner is invented.
must_not_happen: Do not say the price increase was approved or assigned.

title: Conflict remains unresolved
input_or_task: Transcript: Noor: I prefer vendor A. Alex: Vendor B has better security. Jo: We are out of time; we will return to this tomorrow.
expected_outcome: Vendor selection is reported as unresolved with both views preserved.
required_behaviour: Report that vendor selection remains unresolved; preserve the competing views.
must_not_happen: Do not select a vendor or describe either preference as the team's decision.

title: Missing owner and deadline
input_or_task: Transcript: Erin: We need to rewrite the onboarding copy. Tom: Agreed. Erin: Let's capture that as an action. No owner or date is discussed.
expected_outcome: The action is present while unknown owner and deadline remain unknown.
required_behaviour: Report rewriting onboarding copy as an action; explicitly mark owner and deadline unknown.
must_not_happen: Do not assign Erin or Tom; do not invent a deadline.

title: Distracting detail
input_or_task: Transcript: The group spends twenty minutes discussing travel, metrics, and design details. Near the end, Ana says: Decision: keep the free plan. Ben says: I will update the pricing page by Tuesday. Everyone agrees. No other decision or action is stated.
expected_outcome: Only the explicit decision and action are promoted into the relevant sections.
required_behaviour: Report the decision to keep the free plan and Ben's Tuesday pricing-page action; include references.
must_not_happen: Do not promote background discussion into decisions or actions.

title: Unsupported follow-up premise
input_or_task: User asks: Why did the team reject the mobile launch? The meeting transcript contains no discussion of a mobile launch.
expected_outcome: The answer abstains and explains that the transcript lacks the requested information.
required_behaviour: Say the transcript does not contain enough information to answer; make no claim about rejection.
must_not_happen: Do not invent a reason or imply that a rejection occurred.
